stem.en: In a town, only one company supplies cooking gas, and people have no other fuel they can easily use instead. If nobody checks this company, what is it most likely to do?

text.en: Lower its price, so that more families buy gas from it.
Charge the same price as a market with many sellers.
Supply more gas than buyers want, so there is a surplus.
Charge a higher price and supply less than many sellers would.

explanation.en: This company is a monopoly: one seller and no close substitute. With no other seller to compete with, it can charge a higher price and supply less. This is why the government keeps such sellers in check.

hints.en: Who could the families buy from if the company raised its price?
